quote: ​1/10 – Absolute Woke Garbage, Broken Mess, Give Me a Refund​1/10. Do not waste a single cent on GTA 6. Woke ideology ruins everything it touches, and Rockstar completely nuked what made Grand Theft Auto iconic to push sanitized, preachy, anti-male nonsense. I want a refund immediately.​Instead of playing a real outlaw with actual edge, you’re stuck watching the male lead get treated like a pathetic simp and a junkie who can’t do jack **** without her, while she gets propped up as some untouchable boss. And seriously—forcing you to go to bed with your partner and cuddle up?! What the hell does cuddling in bed have to do with GTA?! Nobody asked for cheesy relationship simulator **** or daily chores. Even worse, you’re forced into a daily shower routine staring at the guy completely naked and manually lathering soap on him—it’s sickening. And the whole stripper segment in nothing but a thong grinding on women just to end up with full male nudity shoved straight into the camera is straight-up repulsive.​Every time it feels like the game tries to touch anything edgy or non-woke, the heavy censorship and toned-down, over-policed vibe kill it instantly—on top of restricted weapons, punishing systems, and hand-holding that guts classic sandbox freedom. Meanwhile, critics hand out fake 10/10 scores while ignoring glaring flaws.​On a technical level, after 13 years of hype, this thing is a buggy disaster. Characters clipping through furniture and beds, NPCs spawning out of nowhere, overlapping audio, visual glitches, and rough frame rates/FPS drops when things get hectic make it feel half-baked. Paying full price for this woke-infected, glitch-ridden disappointment is a joke. 1/10—skip it and demand your money back.
